why_not_curated: CCCBDB's entry (citing Coussan et al. 1998, a matrix-isolation IR paper) is incomplete (no H-C-H / H-C-C angles) and its Cartesians contradict its own internal list (methyl C-H 1.088/1.098 assigned to swapped atoms). Recommend: the trans-ethanol microwave structure from the primary literature, or PubChem3D (CID 702) + HF/6-31G refinement.
